audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart had Skill on rows 0,1,3,5 and gave Aurelion Sol the 2+ items row, while content win[] and packet levelChart give Sylas ALL seven stages.
audit.why: Asol is immobile, channel-locked and stack-dependent; Sylas interrupts the Q channel with Abduct at every stage and even late the melee brawl beats the channel-reliant kit — content whys and packet agree on a full Sylas sweep.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned to Sylas on every row, whys rewritten; the contradictory Aurelion Sol 2+ items row corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and whys[4] name 'Cosmic Rift' — Aurelion Sol's ultimate is Falling Star / The Skies Descend; 'Cosmic Rift' does not exist. wants.foe[1] labels Singularity as (R) when it is his E.
audit.why: Kit file is authoritative: R is Falling Star, upgrading to The Skies Descend; Singularity is E.
audit.corrected: Both fabricated/mislabeled names replaced with the real ones.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no digit and no sequencing advice existed anywhere (packet defect); Singularity's center-execute and pull never reached the page.
audit.why: Kit: W (Astral Flight) 22s rank 1 — his only mobility; E (Singularity) 12s with an execute threshold at its center; R 120/110/100s. Both Q and W are channels, so any CC — including a stolen stun — cancels them.
audit.corrected: Numbers plus the wait-for-W-before-you-commit sequencing written into breakdown.cooldowns; the execute folded into spikes[3].text.

audit.why: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to their titles with kit-grounded content.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Sylas

edits.before: Q-poke the wave contacts — the chain detonation chips while you wait for the real kit at 3.
edits.after: He farms passively with no early damage — your Chain Lash pokes him straight off his stack camp.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Sylas

edits.before: W joins: the heal-strike makes even trades dishonest — yours refunds, his doesn't.
edits.after: He is immobile and channel-locked on Q — W's heal-strike wins every step-up trade you take.

edits.before: Full kit: E2-chain into Q-W with passive whirls is the lane's best level-3 all-in nobody respects yet.
edits.after: Abduct yanks him clean out of his Breath of Light channel — every interrupt kills damage AND stacks.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Sylas

edits.before: Chain-trade on cooldown: shield in, stun, whirl the passive autos, heal out. The brawl is the plan.
edits.after: He cannot answer your all-in while stacking — chain-trade on cooldown and own the lane through 4-5.

edits.before: Hijack online — your R is whatever his best button is. The lane's power budget just became a shared account.
edits.after: Hijack plus Abduct bursts him before Falling Star lands, and he has no escape once Astral Flight is spent.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Sylas

edits.before: First item spike: full chains with a stolen ult delete or out-brawl anything mid offers.
edits.after: Your item spike keeps him pinned before stack-scaling matters — roam and dive off the tempo.

edits.before: Aurelion Sol
edits.after: Sylas

edits.before: Late Sylas shops the enemy team: steal the fight-flipper, flank with it, and heal through the refund policy.
edits.after: Even late, melee brawls beat his channel-reliant kit — force the fight, just never sit in his black hole.

edits.before: - Aurelion Sol Astral Flight: matchup-defining — His reposition and escape — he is a stationary battery while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Abscond (shield-dash) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1 and it is his only escape — wait for him to fly, then commit; he is a stationary battery for the next 20 seconds. - Singularity cycles every 12s and its center executes low HP. - Falling Star runs 120/110/100s; your Hijack 80/55/30s.

edits.before: E-shield in, E2-chain, Q-W with whirls between, heal out — the full brawl string he answered with one rotation and regret.
edits.after: Both his Q and W are channels — a stolen stun or your Abduct cancels them mid-cast, so the early steal turns his own kit into the off switch.

edits.before: Chaining into a loaded CC with W down — Sylas without the heal is a mage who chose melee for the aesthetic.
edits.after: Every minute you sit on the steal he banks Stardust — his whole plan is surviving to the stack spike, so spend fights early and often.

edits.before: Your Hijack + Abduct bursts him before Cosmic Rift lands, and he has no escape at 6.
edits.after: Your Hijack + Abduct bursts him before Falling Star lands, and he has no escape at 6.

edits.before: Cosmic Rift (R) is a slow-charging ult; all-in him before he can channel it, and Kingslayer (W) sustains you through his Breath of Light tick damage.
edits.after: Falling Star (R) stuns, but he has no escape — all-in him before the star drops, and Kingslayer (W) sustains you through his Breath of Light tick damage.

edits.before: Even late your melee brawl beats his immobile, channel-reliant kit. Force fights and never let him free-cast Singularity from range.
edits.after: Even late your melee brawl beats his channel-reliant kit — but Singularity's center executes at low HP, so never brawl inside the black hole.

edits.before: Scale Singularity (R) radius for teamfights
edits.after: Scale Singularity (E) radius for teamfights

edits.before: Through 6 you dictate everything. Abduct pulls him out of his Breath of Light channel, killing both his damage and his stack income, and he has no escape to punish the commit. Even after 6 your Hijack plus grapple bursts him before Falling Star or Cosmic Rift can matter. Every interrupt is tempo stolen from his scaling — dive him, deny him, keep him starved.
edits.after: Through 6 you dictate everything. Abduct pulls him out of his Breath of Light channel, killing both his damage and his stack income, and he has no escape to punish the commit. Even after 6 your Hijack plus grapple bursts him before Falling Star or The Skies Descend can matter. Every interrupt is tempo stolen from his scaling — dive him, deny him, keep him starved.

notes: Fabricated ult name 'Cosmic Rift' killed in whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid — real R is Falling Star, upgrading to The Skies Descend per the kit file. Singularity mislabeled (R) in wants.foe[1] corrected to (E). Chart: content win[] and packet both give Sylas all seven stages; full rows 0,1,3,5 moved from Skill to Sylas and the contradictory 'Aurelion Sol' 2+ items row moved to Sylas (its old why also described the owner winning). Packet's 'no sequencing advice' defect addressed in breakdown.cooldowns (wait for Astral Flight, then commit). Missing interactions covered: Singularity execute threshold in spikes[3].text and breakdown.cooldowns; the resistances-invalidated line (E percent-health) not separately added — itemization already leans HP/sustain, and I had no verified magnitude to state.
